name: Ma Chih-yüan
bio: Ma Chih-yüan (馬致遠, c. 1250–1321) was a dramatist and poet of the Yüan dynasty, ranked among the leading writers of the age of Mongol rule. He is best known for the zaju play Autumn in the Han Palace (漢宮秋) and is counted among the four great Yüan dramatists.

He was also a master of the sanqu, the free-standing song form set to popular tunes. His short piece to the tune Tian jing sha, on autumn thoughts, is among the most admired lyrics in the Chinese tradition.

poems.title: 天淨沙·秋思 (Tian jing sha · Qiu si)
poems.author: Ma Chih-yüan
poems.text:
枯藤、老樹、昏鴉。
小橋、流水、人家。
古道、西風、瘦馬。
夕陽西下，斷腸人在天涯。
